questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: That it was a student city with a healthy student environment and that it was a great university. I also wanted to go to a city that was different from Copenhagen to try something new and Heidelberg has definitely lived up to my expectations. As I study German language and culture, Germany was the perfect country to go to, to learn the German language.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The whole process before doing an exchange was way too complicated and outdated. I would recommend to make this part more simple and up to date.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Heidelberg Universität website was a bit complicated.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I got a buddy, who helped me out with a lot of different stuff - both within and, as well as out of University. That was very helpful.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: I found it thorough WG-Gesucht and got a room after my first interview.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Heidelberg is not that big so even though you live off campus you are not that far from anything. I would definitely recommend finding housing on your own in stead of doing it through the university. The people who did that were quite unhappy with where they got to live.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: If you are in Heidelberg, then find housing on your own.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I don't really remember but it wasn't that complicated.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: A buddy - Another student who already knew the system.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes that I wanted

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Register early so you can get the classes you want before they are filled up

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: They were good.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Much more academic and serious. The level in Copenhagen is a bit humble and German language and culture doesn't have much structure, what we on the other hand got to experience here.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
1. Grundlagen des wissenschaftlichen Schreibens
2. B2.2 Sprachkurs
3. Aussteigen in Literatur und Film der Gegenwart
4. Medienikonen

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Aussteigen in Literatur und Film der Gegenwart - Great teacher
